items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Tiny inline trend chart for stat cards / table cells / dashboard widgets. Line or area variant, optional tooltip, renders responsively into its parent. Built on Recharts.

items.name: metric-grid
items.title: MetricGrid (KPI row with comparison)
items.description: Responsive grid of KPI cards with built-in trend arrow + colour, comparison-vs-previous-period rendering, optional sparkline slot, optional icon, and loading-skeleton state.
